items.text: The following changes are available in HAWKED as of the latest update on Thursday, December 05, 2024. Update your game to play the latest version of HAWKED for free on your platform of choice.

Fixed the light from the buds not turning off in the Wilting Blossoms Encounter.

Fixed a bug with crystals not working in the Disciple Altar Encounter.
Fixed an issue allowing access inside the base of the Pressure Pillar.

Fixed an issue with the Wrath Raven Class Card description.
Fixed the "Old Friends" Quest description.
Eclipsa now summons the correct number of illusions for each enemy player.
Players can now equip two identical weapons in different slots.
New players now receive the Hardtack pistol and Muldoon shotgun as starter weapons.
Improved readability in the Broken Path Encounter.
Improved visuals in the Crystal Prison Encounter

releases.displayName: New Update: Traverse Realities in Issue #3: Worlds Beyond!

items.text: A new corruption has shattered X-Isle’s fate, mutating all it touches. Dive right into a brave new Reality… or should we say Realities? Reality shatters, corruption spreads — experience the chaos in Issue #3: Worlds Beyond, a new update available for HAWKED on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One!

Tackle co-op PvE Expeditions together with friends to advance Storylines across three distinct Realities. Take on rival Renegades Solo or as a Squad in PvP Mode. Gain the support of GRAIL’s finest with the Reputation System, and craft affix-charged Artifacts through Synthesis. Loot more Artifacts and equip the Loadouts of Renegade legends with new Class Cards.

Celebrate the launch by tuning into streams with Twitch Drops active until December 2, Refer a Renegade to nab loot as the squad gathers, upgrade your hunt with an Expansion Pass, and grab the Renegade Pass #3 to progress as you plunder!
Ready to loot new Realities? For a full breakdown of all the changes in this mega update, check out the full patch notes.

The Heart of the Island unleashed, the world has shattered into three Realities: The Disciples, VEKTR, and GRAIL. It’s up to you Renegades to team up, venture across them all, and bring them back to the true timeline in the long-awaited PvE Expedition Mode, a swashbuckling co-op adventure for Squads of up to three players (with no PvP rivalry)!

Assist Tabytha in defeating The Elder in the Disciple’s Kingdom (available for free in the base game), and join Nellie on her path of vengeance against Bodhi through VEKTR’s Invasion or tag alongside Bjorn to save GRAIL from the brink of greed from the Corrupted Heartland in Realities (included with the Realities Expansion Pass).
Embark on each hunt against ever-changing odds as match-altering Mutators shift reality, and dare to delve through the final Vault within the Treasury to grab the ultimate prize!

notes.title: CULTIVATE A CUTTHROAT CAREER IN PVP MODE

items.text: Squad up or gun down rivals Solo in Treasure Hunt PvP Modes with slight adaptations to align the format to PvE Expeditions.

Take on rival Renegades in a race to collect 3 Glyphs (yes, instead of 4!), unlock the Treasury, and run the gauntlet in the final Vault to nab the ultimate Artifact prize. The risks are certainly high with not only rivals to contend with but increased damage from PvE enemies – but the reward matches the risk with a higher loot value!

notes.title: RESCUE NEW ALLIES, CHALLENGE OLD FOES

items.text: An old forgotten signal has flared up in all the madness, coming from an old guard of GRAIL long thought lost to a storm of endless alternate dimensions. CAPS has been traversing the dimensions for centuries, a little chaos here, and some Renegade wits there might just help him find his way.

As for Bodhi Hogan, he’s triple the threat as his reality has split across the three X-Isles. Could be a good moment for him to do some soul-searching… or maybe just get dealt a triple dose of justice.

Rise up in the hearts and minds of GRAIL’s Finest by fostering friendships with your favorite characters. Follow the Story and complete Story Quests and Mastery Quests in three Reputation Tracks — Nellie, Bjorn, and Tabytha — across the Expedition Realities they’re tied to. Learn more about the dangers ahead in the Realities & Expeditions Feature Spotlight
NOTE: Your Character Reputation levels will be persistent from Issue to Issue. GRAIL Loyalty will be removed in Issue #3: Worlds Beyond, and all previous progress will be transferred to Reputation.

Find a purpose for each and every piece of loot you extract from X-Isle — including your hoard of duplicate Artifacts and Trinkets — through Synthesis! Experiment with their qualities, upgrade their abilities, and unleash the ultimate power of Charged Artifacts on your unsuspected foes by empowering them with Legendary, Masterwork, and Corrupted Affixes unique to each Artifact.
Curious to see how to get your hands on such terrible treasures? Read the Feature Spotlight on Charged Artifacts for all things Affixes.

Go on Expeditions into the dystopian Reality of VEKTR’s Invasion and the eldritch nightmare of the Corrupted Heartlands and see if you can brave their dangers long enough to get your hands on these newly discovered Artifacts, and your boots safely back to the Riftwake!

Wyvern’s Wail:GRAIL scientists believe the Wyvern's Wail was originally designed to record messages, allowing the lost civilization to dictate notes and preserve their history. Unfortunately, the only recordings we've recovered so far are angry exchanges between bickering couples and a few badly performed original songs. Still, we'll keep searching.

Leatherneck:The lost people revered the armadillo for its natural ability to withstand sudden attacks, and the Leatherneck embodies this philosophy by offering a last-second surge of protection to adventurers in dire situations. Rumors also say the lost people used armadillos for lawn bowling, but these reports cannot be confirmed.

Limb Regrower:This Artifact is modeled after a wounded reptile in brumation, resting away its worries and pains, soon to emerge as a renewed, stronger creature. We advise all Renegades to practice similar self-care, though be aware that limb regrowth remains just beyond our current capabilities.

Sea Shroud:Further supporting the lost people's strong connection to the sea, this treasured piece is shaped like an octopus. We haven’t found any octopus around X-Isle, but given the Artifact's invisibility-granting power, they're probably just very good at hiding.
Find more about their abilities and upgrade qualities in the full Issue #3: Worlds Beyond patch notes!
New legends have joined the Renegade pantheon! Don their Loadouts and wield their tricks with four new Class Cards in the deck.
Medusara, The Sea Shield: It pays to have friends in low places.: Effect: The Familiar’s Boon Gear and jellyfish clusters on X-isle grant you 50% more shields.
Loadout: Doomerang, Familiar’s Boon, Sea Shroud, Specter’s Gaze, Hermit’s Crown
Rita Redline, The Risk-taker: Risk it all for a good shot.: Effect: You gain 20% firearm critical chance for 3 seconds after taking damage.
Loadout: Kick-back Coin, Smoke Blast, Limb Regrower, Revenger’s Lamp, Powerglass.
Malice Alice, The Tormentor: A master of misfortune, without mercy.: Effect: You deal 15% more direct damage to enemies suffering from negative effects.
Loadout: Devoider, Hit Flask, Wyvern’s Wail, Ballistic Bag, Pioneer’s Piton
Overload Ed, The Living Battery: Discharge your damage.: Effect: When your Shield boost is exhausted, deal 100% equal shock damage to the closest enemy.
Loadout: Blockade Ram, Snap-Track, Leatherneck, Shellblazer, Scallop Shield

notes.title: UPGRADE YOUR HUNT WITH AN EXPANSION PASS

items.text: Embrace the chaos of Issue #3: Worlds Beyond entirely with a Realities Expansion Pass or Master of Realities Expansion Pass. Loaded with all you need to experience new worlds to the fullest, they’re your ticket to access two new Realities, new factions, reputations, bonus loadout content, and more!
Raise your Reputation: Unlock two new Reputation Tracks for more rewards as you rise up in the hearts and minds of GRAIL’s Finest.
Collect Class Cards: Discover new legendary Renegades and adopt their Loadouts to your playstyle.
Master Crafting: Unlock new heights of power and quality by crafting Masterwork and Corrupted Charged Artifacts through Synthesis.
Hunt New Realities: Experience VEKTR’s Invasion and the Corrupted Heartlands by going on Expeditions in two new Realities.
Battle Different Factions: Battle the Corrupted and VEKTR, and contend with unique enemy types, abilities, and mobs.
Collect more Customizations: Unlock a host of new options, from vibrant Outfits to terrific Weapon Skins.
Loot More: Discover more Artifacts and seek out exciting new ways to treasure-hunt on X-Isle!

Unlock all these features with either Expansion Pass, with a bundle of bonus content with the Realities Expansion Pass, and even more in the Master of Realities Expansion Pass — purchase yours from the website today!
The DLC is also available on Steam (Realities | Master of Realities), PlayStation Store (Realities | Master of Realities), and Microsoft Store (Realities | Master of Realities).

notes.title: UNLOCK 50+ REWARDS IN THE RENEGADE PASS #3

items.text: Grab the all-new Renegade Pass #3 to progress as you plunder! Reap the rewards of over 50 levels including the seasonal Fringe Farer Avatar and its four collectible variations, the Golden Girl/Boy Outfits, Rave Rocker UltraTraverser, Glitter Weapon Pattern, Lockers, Weapon Skins, Headwear, and that’s only a few of just the Cosmetics as it features a nice number of Hawks, Wonderium, and GE-0 Cash in between.
Check out the full progression and all the goodies in the Renegade Pass #3 article.

Celebrate the release of Issue #3: Worlds Beyond with Twitch Drops open to all HAWKED streams until December 2! Tune in, tally up time, and earn the Jester Color Scheme, the Voxel Kitty Hat, GRAIL+ Subscription, and more.
Find the full list of rewards and how to link your account in our Twitch Drops article.

Call in the reinforcements, and loot good doing it. Invite friends to X-Isle via your unique Refer a Renegade link to earn exclusive rewards like the Shooting Stars Weapon Pattern, Riot Mask, Voxel Traverser, and more when they complete their Referral Quest and extract Trinkets!
Share your link far and wide, there’s no limit — read more on how it works here.

Have you got your party suits? The good times are rolling! Get the Party Bot Avatar and the otherworldly Alien Raver Bundle, as well as a 20% discount on the Rainforest Body, Legwear, and Headwear from the Shop until November 14!
Visit the Shop to find the full collection of cosmetics! Stop by the lower deck of the Riftwake and chat with GE-0, or access it via the navigation menu.

It’s a trip when you’re going worlds beyond — so keep the intel close! Join our Discord to get updated on community events as they come, meet the wider Renegade crowd, and find fellow hunters to squad up. You can also follow HAWKED on TikTok, Reddit, Twitch, Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram, and subscribe to our YouTube channel for the latest videos.

Want the intel sent straight to your inbox? Sign up for the official newsletter and get the edge on other Renegades with news about updates, events, special offers, and more, not to mention the occasional free goodie like the Ace Archaeologist Hat!

Look alive, Renegades! The following changes are available in HAWKED as of the latest update on Thursday, November 14, 2024. Update your game to play the latest version of HAWKED for free on your platform of choice.
This major content update will introduce the next exciting chapter of HAWKED — Issue #3: Worlds Beyond.

Team up in swashbuckling co-op PvE Expeditions, continue your Renegade’s storyline, raise your Reputations across three faction tracks, craft your Loadout with Synthesis, and pit your wits against the Corrupted Heartlands map in the mega update for Issue #3: Worlds Beyond, out November 14.
ISSUE #3: WORLDS BEYOND

With the Heart of the Island unleashed, X-Isle has shattered into three Realities. It’s up to you Renegades to team up, venture across them all, and bring them back to the true timeline in the long-awaited PvE Expeditions Mode with three unique Realities: Disciple’s Kingdom, VEKTR’s Invasion, and Corrupted Heartlands.
Team up in the long-awaited [PvE Expeditions Mode], a swashbuckling co-op adventure for Squads of up to three players (with no PvP rivalry)!
In Expedition Mode, teams are friendly towards each other.
Treasuries now grant access to Vaults.
Extraction is only possible through the Vault.
The gym memberships have paid off, and all mob armies have undergone significant changes, becoming much stronger and more dangerous.
Disciple and VEKTR armies have expanded with new mob varieties.
Enemy logic placement has been reworked to include patrols, and some mob squads now respawn.
Enemies now appear in all Encounters.
Enemy reactions to melee attacks have been revamped.

The all-new unique PvE Expeditions map! A manifestation of GRAIL’s own misplaced ambitions, the Corrupted Heartland is a dark and twisted Reality of greed left unchecked. The force unleashed by the Heart of the Island plagues X-Isle, corrupting everything its tendrils latch on to – weapons, Artifacts, even living beings.

Seeking to confront the consequences of GRAIL’s actions, Bjorn has set out to find a remedy for the corruption and soothe the powers of the Heart. A challenge even for the most experienced Renegades, The Corrupted Heartlands Reality features enemies never before confronted.
No longer the only game mode, the Squad and Solo Treasure Hunt Modes have been adapted to a format similar to PvE Expeditions, featuring Vaults.
Players from other teams are hostile.
Players must collect 3 Glyphs instead of 4 to unlock the Treasury and access the Vault
Players cannot respawn automatically—only through allies at Revive Points.
Increased PvE difficulty.
Increased loot value.
Extraction is only possible through the Vault.
Cursed Chests: a valuable find containing valuable loot – but also guarded by some serious dangers!

Treasuries no longer contain an Artifact, but a portal to a Vault. These dangerous dungeons are full of traps and enemies, and only the most skilled treasure hunters and adventurers can brave their corridors and rooms to seize the Artifacts from their final chambers.
What happens in the Treasury, stays in the Treasury. Once entered, players can only leave through the Extraction Point at its end.

Rise up in the hearts and minds of GRAIL’s Finest by fostering friendships with your favorite characters. Follow the Story and complete Story Quests and Mastery Quests in three Reputation Tracks — Nellie, Bjorn, and Tabytha — across the Expedition Realities they’re tied to.

Story Quests: Advance the storyline and delve into the character’s activities and motivations, revealing more of HAWKED’s overall storyline. They can only be completed once and grant a lot of Reputation.

Mastery Quests: These are mostly focused on quantitative gathering or mastery of something, with a narrative less impactful to the main story. They are repeatable but grant less Reputation than Story Quests.

Players gain a variety of rewards for increasing their Reputation levels with access to purchasing new Gear, Weapons, Mods, Reserves Slots, and Expendables from the GRAIL armory. Players at the maximum level of a Reputation Track can tackle Challenges, rewarding access to especially powerful weapons upon completion.
Players are granted free access to Tabytha’s Reputation Track. Bjorn's and Nellie's Reputation Tracks are unlocked with the Realities Expansion Pass or Master of Realities Expansion Pass.
NOTE: Your Character Reputation levels will be persistent from Issue to Issue. GRAIL Loyalty will be removed in Issue #3: Worlds Beyond, and all previous progress will be transferred to Reputation.

Find a purpose for each and every piece of loot you extract from X-Isle — including your hoard of duplicate Artifacts and Trinkets — through Synthesis! Experiment with their qualities, upgrade their abilities, and unleash the ultimate power of Affixes through three kinds of Charged Artifacts: Legendary, Masterwork, and Corrupted.
Masterwork and Corrupted Artifacts are unlocked with the Realities Expansion Pass or Master of Realities Expansion Pass.
GE-0 has opened a Black Market where players can spend their hard-earned Hawks on a selection of Trinkets and Artifacts. The selection refreshes daily, though he won’t tell how he procures them.
Master the craft of Synthesis and charge your Artifacts with dangerous Affixes of Legendary, Masterwork, and Corrupted qualities.
Legendary Quality Affix: Grants an additional quality.
Masterwork Quality Affix: Grants an improvement to an Artifact’s existing attributes.
Corrupted Quality Affix: Kiss/Curse mechanic that grants an improvement alongside a Corruption that significantly alters the Artifact's use in gameplay.

Each Artifact has its own unique Affix for all three qualities, so get crafting and see what powers they hold once pushed to the limit. Affix charges are consumed each time a player enters a match, reverting to the Artifact’s Epic quality once full depleted. Artifacts can be charged up with Affixes again through Synthesis.
A new quality for weapons wrapped by eldritch tendrils and warped by unique Affixes, sure to be useful to whoever dares wield them!
Increased attack efficiency.
Each carried Corrupted weapon increases incoming damage.
Only found in-match, dropped by Hexed Renegades (enemy type).
LOOT CHANGES

It is now possible to extract Weapons, Mods, and Armaments to be used in a later match, or kept in storage. It is also possible to purchase these items before the match using in-game currency. New items become available and storage capacity increases based on Reputation levels or completion of Quests. NOTE: Some items can only be found in a match or purchased from the Shop.
Weapon chests now come in three qualities: Uncommon, Rare, and Epic.
Loadout now has additional slots for armament weapons and Mods.
Caravans now drop a loot dispenser, allowing all Renegades who participate in bringing the beasts of burden down a share of the spoils.
The Heart Glyph has been removed — all players now can respawn from the start of the match.
Mutators: Match-altering effects randomly applied at the beginning of a session.

Solo Player Buffs: Players with an incomplete squad will now receive additional resurrections through Heart Glyphs. +1 to each player in a 2-player squad, +3 to solo players.: Players receive +25 Shield and +25 Health for each absent teammate.
Players receive a +50%/100% increase to their PvE damage for each absent teammate.
Players will receive a decrease of -1/-2 to their Shield recharge time.
Knuckleheads: No longer needs a Shroudbasker rider to wreak havoc.
Slabscales: It’s a family reunion for the big fellas as distant cousins join the tribe; the poisonous Corroder, the fiery Scalder, and vicious Summoner.
Gamma Unit: Now occasionally yeets mines.
Poison Croaker: Croaker but poison.
[Hunt Artifact] Wyvern’s Wail: When they think it’s over, make them think again.
Effect: Each time you discharge a firearm, gain one charge. When reloading the same firearm, or it overheats, release shrapnel shards for each stored charge, each dealing up to 5 damage.
You lose all charges when swapping weapons. Store up to 7-10 charges.
Legendary Affix: Your Slingshot Traverser fires 6 shrapnel shards with every shot.
Corrupted Affix: Max charges increased to 14, but the spread is increased and shrapnel only fires when the maximum charge is reached.
Masterwork Affix: Shrapnel speed and critical multiplier are increased by 40%.

[Survival Artifact] Leatherneck: A treasure hunter’s gotta have thick skin.: Effect: When Shields are restored to maximum, gain an additional Shield boost for 6-9 seconds. The boost is equal to 100% of the Shield restored in the last 2 seconds. Cannot exceed 30 points.
Legendary Affix: Leatherneck grants 30 shield boost when a negative effect is applied to you. This boost is removed if you have no negative effects.
Corrupted Affix: Shield boosts grant 20% damage resistance, but Shield boosts also decay 2 points per second.
Masterwork Affix: Leatherneck’s Shield boost is no longer limited and is now equal to 125% of the Shield restored in the last 4 seconds.
[Survival Artifact] Limb Regrower: Live to fight another day.: Effect: Restore 45-60% of your missing Health 2.5 seconds after losing Health. Activation timer resets every time you take damage.
Legendary Affix: When Limb Regrower triggers, it also restores Stamina equal to 150% of applied healing.
Corrupted Affix: Activation timer resets after taking any damage (shield and health) but the timer is increased to 4 seconds.
Masterwork Affix: Limb Regrower can restore Health even when you are knocked down.
[Utility Artifact] Sea Shroud: When losing a fight, hide in plain sight.: Effect: Upon losing full Shield capacity, gain invisibility for 6.5-8 seconds.
Legendary Affix: Sea Shroud grants invisibility while in water and for 8 seconds after leaving water.
Corrupted Affix: Sea Shroud invisibility activates after taking any damage, but has a 12-second cooldown between activations.
Masterwork Affix: Sea Shroud invisibility duration is extended by 0.5 seconds for every 10 bonus points to your maximum Shield.
Medusara, The Sea Shield: It pays to have friends in low places.: Effect: The Familiar’s Boon Gear and jellyfish clusters on X-isle grant you 50% more shields.
Loadout: Doomerang, Familiar’s Boon, Sea Shroud, Specter’s Gaze, Hermit’s Crown
Rita Redline, The Risk-taker: Risk it all for a good shot.: Effect: You gain 20% firearm critical chance for 3 seconds after taking damage.
Loadout: Kick-back Coin, Smoke Blast, Limb Regrower, Revenger’s Lamp, Powerglass.
Malice Alice, The Tormentor: A master of misfortune, without mercy.: Effect: You deal 15% more direct damage to enemies suffering from negative effects.
Loadout: Devoider, Hit Flask, Wyvern’s Wail, Ballistic Bag, Pioneer’s Piton
Overload Ed, The Living Battery: Discharge your damage.: Effect: When your Shield boost is exhausted, deal 100% equal shock damage to the closest enemy.
Loadout: Blockade Ram, Snap-Track, Leatherneck, Shellblazer, Scallop Shield
Tina Colada: Bringing the party to X-Isle, find her in a match and join her for a dance to spark some fireworks that’ll call down a crate of consumables for you to restock on supplies!
Eclipse: A new Combat Class Card encounter.

Fortune Rifts: Special areas on the map where players can encounter more challenging trials, formidable foes, and valuable loot to match the risk. Fortune Rifts are marked on the map with orange circles, with challenges indicated by orange markers
[Exo Gear] Blockade Ram: No longer has charges. Has a 7/8/9 active duration time and 12 seconds cooldown instead.
Now grants resistance against pulling and pushing abilities.
40/70% of damage taken converts to Shield.
Enemies now consider players using a barrier a priority target.
[Exo Gear] Kick-back Coin: Every coin ricochet splits bullets in two.
Legendary quality decreases Gear cooldown from 20 to 15 seconds.
[Exo Gear] Doomerang: Can now ricochet from the same target more than once.
[Ward Gear] Shock Rocker: No longer converts damage dealt to your Shield.
Cohort's Kite: Healing per second is decreased from 6/7/8 to 3/4/5.
Flare Gun: Rare quality now reduces cooldown up to 50% depending on the amount of supplies in a player’s inventory.
Boosters have been removed.
GRAIL+ now grants an equal amount of Hawks instead of a daily Booster.
Traverser damage bonus is increased from 25% to 40% if no Class Card is active.
[Class Card] Rowan Rocksteady, The Non-Stop Shredder: No longer allows players to play the Shock Rocker infinitely, but increases its duration from 3.5 to 5 seconds.
[Class Card] Kaia Shorebreak, The Hydro Maestro: Max Health bonus persists after leaving water for 20 seconds.
Max Health bonus decreased from 25 to 20.
Bush Masta', The Killer Guerrilla: New Mechanics: +25 Firearm damage to PvP targets out of combat, +100 to PvE enemies.
El Toro Loco, The Hardened Guardian: New Mechanics: Shield recharges 35% faster while a Gear is active.
Eclipsa, The High Grounder: Damage bonus is increased from 30% to 35%.
Far-Eyed Falcon, The All-Seeing: New Mechanics: 10% chance to deal critical damage when attacking scanned targets.
Wrath Raven, The Savage Scav: New Mechanics: Scorn Trophies drop 30% more often from defeated enemies. Performing a finisher on a rival Renegade pings the next closest one.
Base and cap Shield/Health values have changed: Base Shield: 50 to 20
Base Health: 125 to 150
Cap Shield: 125 to 100
Cap Health: 175 to 200
Melee attacks no longer deal damage through Shield.
Disguise changes: Enemy detection radius has increased, while detection speed has been significantly reduced.
Reactivating disguise leads enemies to briefly lose sight of you.
If enemies detect a disguised player, they will see themselves outlined in red.
Scanning effects now increase critical damage (e.g. weak spot damage) instead of a random chance to deal damage.
Enemy stats have been rebalanced.
Enemies will now attack knocked-down players if there are no other potential targets within a certain radius.
Enemy distribution has changed across all maps.
Improved shooting impact against creatures.
Elite VEKTR units now spawn random drones instead of specifically assigned ones.
Theta units will now shoot while moving, increasing attack speed with each shot
Feather: Max ammo bonus is decreased from 100 to 50.
Harvest: Ammo restoration is decreased from 100 to 50.
Sun: Bonus Shield value is decreased from 20 to 10.
Potion: Health restoration is decreased from 3 to 1 point per second.
Flower: Health restoration is decreased from 5 to 3 points per second.
Legendary Trinkets no longer provide Stamina bonuses.
Carrying a VEKTR Epic Trinket now grants +5 to your maximum Shield.
Anti-Shield Grenades have been redesigned for PvE.
UI IMPROVEMENTS
The Quest log has been reworked: Added menu with categories representing all Quest types.
Daily and Weekly Quests have been removed and are now displayed in a separate section on the Renegade Pass menu.
The Loot page has been reworked: Now also shows Mods, Shield, and Weapons alongside Treasures, Artifacts, and Currency.
Shows Affix depletion of Charged Artifacts (Legendary, Masterwork, and Corrupted)
PvP damage and PvP kill count columns have been removed from PvE Mode statistics menu.
Some achievements have been adjusted due to the introduction of new mechanics and the removal of old ones. All progress players have made in existing achievements will carry over to the updated ones.
(Previously) Agent of GRAIL: Reach GRAIL Loyalty Level 10.
(New)Inner Circle: Reach maximum Reputation with any veteran Renegade.Was Booster Shopper - Purchase 100 Boosters from the GRAIL shop.
Now:Decked Out - Purchase 100 items for your Loadout.
Ripclaws: Discovered hot sauce, now breathes fire.
Fanatics: Now throw fire whirlwinds while attempting to escape.
Added hit visuals for ranged creature attacks on players.
Added precast animation to Gamma’s Dash ability.
Added precast animation to Spitfire’s Rush ability.
Caravans don’t have time for traffic and now push creatures out of the way.
Changed color pallet of different creature classes, making them more distinct.
Croakers will now move less between each shot.
Improved caravan chest positioning on the ground.
Increased collision of VEKTR alarms Crystals, making them easier to hit
The Mass Heal ability of the Champion Fanatic now accounts for line of sight to heal targets.
Players attempting to complete puzzler Encounters are now ambushed by enemies.
Some enemies have been to a few drama classes. Slabscales and Delta units now feature new death animations with a flair for the dramatic.
Improved visibility of VEKTR Drone weak points.
Weapon slots are now squared in line with other item slots.
AFK players can no longer revive allies at Resurrection Points.
The final section of the tutorial now has a Vault section, just like the main session.
Added cooldown on stagger from Traverser melee attacks.
Taking damage now shakes the crosshair/reticule.
Trinkets, stashes, and weapon chests no longer appear on the mini-map.

Fresh Ambition: new players, as well as players who have not logged into the game for over two weeks, receive the "Fresh Ambition" effect, reducing PvE damage taken and gradually diminishing across five matches.
Added localization for Class Card Encounter NPCs.
Fixed a rare issue where Slabscales couldn't be damaged.
Fixed an issue where totems wouldn’t properly apply invisibility on themselves.
Bodhi Illusions are no longer displayed as "REDACTED (Eclipsa) Illusion" when killed
Fixed an issue where the visual effect of the Bang-O-Matic Gear showed an incorrect radius.
Agent Kappa visually matches his Class Card now.
Fixed a bug where the Chosen’s Token Artifact didn’t appear with its characteristic glow and beam when on the ground.
Empower shot VFX no longer appears when you hit blue crystals.
Class Cards encounters now properly account for players' invisibility.
Fixed an issue causing Drones to get stuck in one place.
Fixed an issue causing Epsilon Units to switch between assist and mobility mode when shot.
Fixed an issue causing Shroudbasker Poison Grenade to last longer than its visuals.
Fixed an issue with players not losing their Hoverboard if their Wave Glyph wears off while in midair.
Fixed an issue where Spy Drone animations wouldn’t work properly.
Fixed a Bodhi movement animation where he would freeze in shock at the sight of an Artifact on the ground.

items.text: Tech and treasure hunting go head-to-head in Venture 2 of Issue #2: Dark Arrival, a major new update now available on all platforms!

Legends rise as a kick-ass, not-that-old Renegade from GRAIL’s ‘old guard’ returns to the fray to fight VEKTR. Extract and exploit the ancient abilities of new Artifacts, shoot foes down with new weapons, wield innovative new Gear, and master four new Class Cards — just make sure not to fall prey to the Trinket tracker Agent Kappa!
For a full breakdown of all the changes in the Venture 2 update, check out the Update Notes.

notes.title: Tabytha Rasa Returns: GRAIL Reaches for a Star!

items.text: While Renegades have done well patching up the Riftwake, GRAIL has called on a legendary hand at the hunt to deal with the more ‘unconventional’ leaks. Any Renegade worth their salt has heard of The Fearless Blade, and now Tabytha Rasa herself has boarded the Riftwake!

Tabytha Rasa knows Renegades. You could even say she built the brand. While she’s not just here to seek and destroy, join her on her hunt in a new Questline to bring Bodhi to justice and learn a thing or two about how she got her title.
As the hunt rages on, a few changes and discoveries have taken place across X-Isle.
Grab a Glyph: Never cross a Renegade! The Cross Glyph empowers your first shot or weapon hit to a target (Empowered shot bonuses from other sources do not stack).

Encounter Danger: In addition to VEKTR taking over Disciple shrines, there’s a new threat on the block. Agent Kappa rose to infamy for taking aim at Renegades carrying more than just the essentials in their Backpacks. Take care out there, he might just have his sights on your loot next, but take him out first, and he’ll drop an Artifact. Go from hunted to hunter!

Check for Traps: Hoping to foil GRAIL’s efforts of retaking the island, VEKTR has set a few surprises across X-Isle. Alarm Sirens have been raised to disorient intruding Renegades, Shield Domes will block incoming projectiles, and Ping Towers temporarily highlight surrounding enemies, caches, traps, and chests when activated. A smart move, but Renegades have a knack for turning such things to their advantage.
Hurtle wits first into Venture 2 with a fresh array of abilities to suit your skill set.

3 New Artifacts to Loot: Soak in the Healing waters of the Serpent’s Solace, harness the Revenger’s Lamp to highlight threats, or overwhelm your foes with nimble dashes and ferocious melee strikes with the Pioneer’s Piton.

2 New Guns to Shoot: Alternate between lightly tapping for restrained burst fire and holding down the trigger to let the Gundog loose. Or, get your hands on the Brimstone revolver for high-power punishment in the form of five low-spread spray shots.

Gear to Boot: A simple fix to tricky situations, the Smoke Blast Ward Gear is a useful gadget that’ll blast out and push away any enemies at close quarters. It’ll also smoke out profusely upon use, but that’s just a feature to hide your quick escape to more fortunate circumstances!

4 Class Cards as Tribute: A new cast of Renegades has joined the deck! Imbue your Loadout with the elusiveness of Wally Smokes, the healing flow of Kaia Shorebreak, the omniscience of Far-Eyed Faysal, or the mastery of The Fearless Blade, Tabytha Rasa.

Take part in weekly Community Challenges, work together to reach objectives and earn a wide range of rewards from in-game cosmetics and currency to Golden Bounties like controllers, store credit, and more!

This week’s Bounty on Wonderium ends June 28 at 16:00 CEST, so make sure to do your part to extract 2,000,000 Wonderium and earn a community-wide reward, as well as the chance to win an Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2 OR DualSense Edge™.
Keep an eye out for new Bounties every Friday with a fresh set of goals and rewards!

items.text: SMOKE BLAST (WARD GEAR): GRAIL LEVEL IX

GRAIL set out to design a device that could enable Renegades to quickly separate themselves from aggressors. The smokescreen effect was an unexpected addition due to a malfunction in the prototype. But you know what they say: it's not a bug, it's a feature!
If they can't press you, they can't stress you. Here’s what the Smoke Blast is capable of:
Creates a 5/5.5/6 m radius smokescreen. Enemies inside or near the radius will be knocked back 2m outside the radius. The smokescreen lasts for 8 seconds.
The smokescreen grants a disguised status if you do not commit any offensive actions while inside the radius. The visual effect of the smokescreen is diminished for you and your teammates.
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Rare Upgrade: Knock-back distance increased to 4m.
Legendary Upgrade: Smokescreen duration increased to 10 seconds.
Don’t like VEKTR get their hands on them. Three new Artifacts are yours extract, upgrade, and add to your Loadout with all-new abilities.

Serpent’s Solace: Drink from the well of wellbeing. Of the many Artifacts with reptilian design, this offering bowl is the most perplexing. Evidence indicates this bowl was used to source water from deep-running wells across X-Isle. As the lost people believed their deity was resting beneath the island itself, surely it would be a great privilege to drink directly from the source.

Common Quality: Serpent's Solace increases incoming healing by 50%. Healing is increased by consuming an equal amount of charges. The Artifact restores 0.7/0.8/0.9/1 charge(s) per second and can store up to 50 charge(s). The Artifact does not trigger when you are knocked down.
Legendary Quality: While in water or traveling by hoverboard, Serpent's Solace restores 2 charges per second and its healing bonus increases to 100%.
Location: Quest Reward

Pioneer’s Piton: Make your first strike the last. Before his betrayal, Bodhi provided a solid theory as to the original use of this Artifact. Shoved into the cracks of a mountainside, the lost people could use this tool to ascend the high peaks of X-Isle. Otherwise, it would be a long drop to the bottom.
Common Quality: When you sprint for at least 1 second or perform a dodge roll, your next melee attack will deal 15 more damage and disorient the target for 2/2.3/2.6/3 seconds.
Legendary Quality: Bonus melee damage increased to 25.
Location: Found Across X-Isle

Revenger’s Lamp: Light the way to vengeance. A higher form of the oil lamp Trinkets found across X-Isle, this Artifact does more than just light the way. As more evidence indicates some sort of civil war between the lost people, surely this lamp was used to mount a quick counter-offensive against shadowy ambushes.
Common Quality: Highlights an enemy for 1.8/2/2.2/2.4 seconds after taking damage from them.
Legendary Quality: If an enemy has highlighted you, they too become highlighted for the same duration.
Location: Found Across X-Isle

Smooth traversal has always been a top priority for HAWKED. We want it to feel intuitive, giving Renegades the same tricks to get around X-Isle while inviting them to rely more on their Gear, Weapons, and treasures to outwit rivals.

That said, the overuse of certain traversal mechanics can make for a negative competitive experience and sap the fun out of the hunt. With Update 1.4.1, we’re making a few changes to how jumping and sprinting work. We toned down the ability to jump non-stop to make combat feel more tactical, and for jumping to be used more selectively, with awareness of its limits. We also made changes to general traversal speed. If you’re only holding a traverser, you’ll be able to explore X-Isle much faster than if you’re primed with a weapon.

Have a read, check out the video, and try them out for yourself when Update 1.4.1 lands this week. As always, we’re reading all your feedback and reviewing match data and will make more changes in the future as necessary.
Jumping is now more heavily affected by a decline depending on how often it is used. This means repetitive actions (such as bunny-hopping) are no longer as effective.
The decline in jumping effectiveness cuts jumping height by 67% rather than 50%.
The decline in jumping effectiveness cuts jumping distance by 33%.
Jumping distance now scales with speed. If you’re not sprinting at maximum speed, your jump distance and height will not be as great.
Your sprinting speed is increased if you run without a weapon in hand.
Stamina now continues to deplete during a jump if you perform it from a sprint or slide.
Stamina consumption while sprinting has been reduced from 10 to 8 units per second.
Haste Buff no longer removes the delay before stamina regeneration after sprinting, sliding, and somersaulting. It also no longer gives bonus speed while sprinting.
Fixed a bug with jump cooldowns not working.

items.text: You’ve got the perfect weapon but despite cracking crate after crate, no luck with the rarity. We have the solution: Extraction Points are now fitted with Upgrade Stations to enhance your weapons in exchange for CRED. You’ll never have to part with your favorite firearms again!
Use an Upgrade Station at an Extraction Point to upgrade certain weapons’ rarities from Uncommon to Rare to Epic.
GRAIL has discovered three new Artifacts waiting to be extracted, upgraded, and added to your Loadout along with all-new abilities.

Attunement Fife: The most nimble of the lost civilization served as messengers across the island. We believe these runners used this Artifact to carry their feet like the wind and hold tight to the message they carried in their minds.

Common Quality: For every second you sprint, slide, or surf, the Attunement Fife grants an Accuracy Buff. Applied after you stop sprinting, sliding, or surfing, and with a maximum Buff duration of 5/6/7/8 seconds. Accuracy Buff reduces weapon recoil.
Legendary Quality: TheArtifact's Buff duration is increased by 3 seconds after performing a dodge roll.
Location: Treasury

Chosen’s Token: The rarity of this token suggests it was only given to a select few within the lost civilization. Some believe it's the seal of a secret society that grew within the civilization. We can only speculate if such a group served to better the civilization or bring about its end.
Common Quality: Chosen's Token converts 40/45/50/55% of damage taken by your Shield to healing.
Legendary Quality: Conversion percentage is increased to 75% if your Health points are lower than your Shield points.
Location: Treasury

Powerglass: This Artifact suggests the builders of the lost civilization were a cut above the rest. Carrying this timekeeper on their belt allowed them to work beyond their normal limitations and still feel refreshed the next day. This enabled them to build towering temples that stood the test of time.
Common Quality: If both your Exo Gear and Ward Gear are on cooldown or recharge, Powerglass reduces their cooldown/recharge time by 40/45/50/55%.
Legendary Quality: One Gear may be active (while the other Gear is in cooldown or recharge) to activate this Artifact's ability.
Location: Venture 3 Questline

Two core Game Modes are now available, including a newly added Solo Mode:
Lone Hunter (Solo): Play by yourself and put your treasure-hunting skills to the test against 29 other solo Renegades.
Treasure Hunt (Squads): Play in teams of two or three and race to the Artifact against other Renegade squads.
Fancy a challenge? Toggle the “Fill Squad” option to enter Treasure Hunt as a solo player or as a duo (find this option in the “Party” interface).

You will receive a random special augment when you pick up a Glyph in Squads. For example, you may be able to pick up more loot during your match. You will receive a notification about your augment when you collect a Glyph.

The Renegade Pass is a type of battle pass that allows you to earn rewards via regular gameplay. Every Issue (season-based event) comes with a Renegade Pass with Free and Premium tracks. You can purchase the Premium track to gain access to the whole pool of rewards while an Issue is active.

Rise through the Renegade ranks by completing Quests to progress the Free or Premium tracks of the Renegade Pass in Issue #1: Renegades. There are 64 rewards to unlock, including unique customizations such as Backpacks, Traversers, Color Schemes, Outfits, GRAIL+, currency, and more.
Check out our dedicated article for more information about Issue #1: Renegades and the Renegade Pass #1.
GRAIL is open for business! As a newly contracted Renegade, know that GRAIL is here to handle your hot extracted merchandise and sell you items to aid your looting or brush up your style.

Gear (available as Exo Gear and Ward Gear) is a type of item used in your Renegade’s Loadout. They provide active skills that can make all the difference in battle and add variety to your standard-issue gunfights. You can equip a maximum of two pieces of Gear at any time (one Exo Gear and one Ward Gear).

Exo Gear allows you to activate a directional tactical ability, while Ward Gear provides you with a non-directional support ability. Each type of Gear is designed to support different playstyles. Certain pieces of Gear may be helpful for all playstyles.

In Early Access, you can experience streamlined Gear progression, more Gear available from the beginning of your Renegade career, simplified access to Gear, and improved presentation of your collection and options via the Loadout menu pre-match.

Boosters are a type of consumable item. You might notice they look a lot like comic books! They’re filled with marvelous tales of heroics, documenting the careers of GRAIL’s most legendary Renegades. As such, Boosters are capable of giving Renegades a morale boost that translates to in-match buffs. The passive skills they can provide you are much simpler than those from Artifacts. In most cases, they offer a tangible buff without additional conditions (there may be exceptions with specific Boosters).
Boosters come in three types that can aid you in different ways: Survival, Utility, and Hunt.

Your ultimate goal on X-Isle. Once you’ve collected enough Glyphs, unlocked the Treasury, and made it out alive through an extraction point, an Artifact will be yours. Artifacts give you passive skills that trigger under certain conditions. Compared to Boosters—which also provide passive skills—Artifacts are much more effective, but you cannot use them at any time. When the effect of an Artifact is triggered, it is accompanied by sound effects and UI notifications.

GRAIL+ is a subscription service that lets you maximize your looting. Benefits of GRAIL+ include:
Colorful Name: Your name becomes orange with a lovely sheen.
Daily Boosters: Boosters give you passive Skills. A maximum of five Boosters can be equipped at a time (you can also buy Boosters with HAWKS in the GRAIL Shop).
Lockbox Slot: Allows you to carry one extra Trinket, which you can save between matches even if you don’t make it to extraction.
Extra Quests: Unlock one additional Weekly Quest and two additional Daily Quests.
20% Experience: Experience lets you level up your Renegade for access to special cosmetic rewards.
Three Emotes: Access additional Emotes in your Loadout, including Finger Shooting, Frustration, and Satisfaction.
Your Quarters are your own personal space aboard the Riftwake. Get familiar with them to enjoy fun asides and a place of respite, with other distractions available elsewhere on GRAIL’s submarine:
Shooting Range: Test your sharpshooting in this arcade-style shooting minigame.
Personal Quarters: Gaze at your hard-earned treasures while your guitar gently weeps.
Main Lobby: It’s time to face the music! Find musical plates behind Bodhi, and shoot at them to make sweet, sweet melodies.

notes.title: Play with new and improved control schemes

items.text: Reworked the default control scheme.
Added different control schemes.
Added Dualshock and Xbox Controller vibration support.
Added support for DualSense Adaptive Triggers.
Rebalanced aim assist when using a controller.
Added a way to preview Gear during character creation.
Added the option to “Sell All Loot” in the Trinkets interface at the GRAIL Shop.
Inactive (AFK) players will not receive shared rewards when in a squad.
Adjusted the functionality of the “Collector Coil”:
Previously: Collector Coil gains a charge that increases your maximum shield for each treasure (Artifacts/Trinkets) you carry in your Backpack.
Now: Collector Coil gains up to 2 charges that increase your maximum shield by 9-15 points for each Trinket carried in your Backpack. Collector Coil becomes fully charged if you hold an Artifact.
Adjusted the visuals of the resurrection point within X-Isle.
Added ultra-wide monitor support.
Improved the visualization of the quest interface.
Improved the display of in-game surveys so we can gather feedback and make adjustments based on community sentiment.
Updated the way the in-session shop currency CRED (formerly called HYPE) works. It is now persistent between sessions.
Improved the visual display of the CRED Store on X-Isle.
Updated the introduction comic sequence that plays when you first start the game.
Added a way to replay the Tutorial from your Personal Quarters.
Updated the HUD to include clearer statuses for teammates in the Squad interface (Disconnected, Left, Dead, and Knocked Down).
Updated settings algorithm to better auto-detect setting options upon first startup.
Improved the minimum graphics preset.
Added more input binding options.
Added more camera and sensitivity options.
Updated the dynamic difficulty scaling of encounters on X-Isle.
Improved client stability and optimization by resolving reported issues of crashing, freezing, and low performance.
Fixed an issue with lip-syncing. Previously, some characters' mouths did not move correctly with their dialogue.
Fixed an issue where the Caravan did not spawn correctly under certain conditions.
Fixed issues with gameplay on the island where terrain was unable to be traversed correctly, and objects and item locations caused some players to get stuck.
Fixed the display of character levels within the Party interface.
Fixed an issue where the screen would freeze when opening the Loadout interface.
Fixed an issue where quest markets were not displayed correctly within specific interfaces.
Fixed an issue where players could fall through the floor when spawning in the Riftwake.
Improved UX bugs in many interfaces.
Fixed an issue when equipping cosmetics, where they would not display correctly after character creation.
Fixed an issue where certain keys couldn’t be rebound when using a keyboard.
Fixed an issue where tips would not display based on the relevant experience for users in the loading screen.
Fixed an issue where buff timers for the Inner Power Booster were incorrectly displayed.
Fixed display of Gear not scaling correctly on debriefing screens such as the Tutorial and Renegade Pass.
Improved the behavior and movement of bots.
Improved the lighting in the final phase, night, and evening on X-Isle.
Fixed collision issues that caused players to get stuck on objects.
Fixed collision and hit registration issues that led to players having trouble hitting enemies.
